paper: arXiv:2609.27308 (EmbodiedSWE: Coding Agents for Long Horizon Dexterous Robotics)

documentation.paper_protocol: one 4-hour run per (task, model), one RTX 4090, Docker; Table 6 of the paper

runtime.why: Isaac Sim 6.2 wheels need glibc 2.35, which hosts such as RHEL 9 do not have (5.1 crashes on the r590 driver, upstream issue #135). Warp precompiled headers are off (SIGBUS on GPFS); the venv's sitecustomize.py sets it.
